candidates.change_summary: Replace the assignment to owner with a no-op (commented) so transferOwnership no longer changes state.
Replace the assignment to owner with assigning owner to msg.sender, preventing change to newOwner and keeping owner as caller.
Replace the assignment to owner with assigning owner to address(0), making owner the zero address after call.
Replace require check to require(msg.sender != owner), inverting the onlyOwner guard so non-owners can call transferOwnership.
Replace require check with require(true) allowing anyone to call functions guarded by onlyOwner, enabling transfers by non-owners.
Replace the onlyOwner modifier body to remove the require check so any caller can pass the guard, allowing non-owners to call owned() which may lead to ownership changes observable via owner state.
Insert an assignment that transfers ownership to msg.sender inside owned(), so calling owned() changes the public owner variable.
Removed the onlyOwner modifier from transferOwnership so anyone can call it and change owner.
Added an extra assignment that sets owner to address(0) after setting to newOwner, causing owner to always be cleared at end of call.
Reversed assignment to set owner to msg.sender instead of the provided newOwner, causing owner to remain caller after call.
Changed the onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender != owner, inverting the check so only non-owners can execute guarded functions like transferOwnership.
Added a conditional that prevents updating owner when newOwner is address(0), leaving owner unchanged if zero address supplied.
